title: Patching the Protocol: A Taxonomy of Pre-Registration Repairs in LLM-Proposer Experiments
title_zh: 修补协议：LLM-提议者实验中预注册修复的分类法

paragraphs.en: 提出LLM提议者实验中预注册协议修复的分类法与检查清单，强调补丁可审计性。 Pre-registration is increasingly proposed as a trust mechanism for machine-learning research involving LLM-generated content, but its canonical form assumes a frozen protocol can be executed unchanged. Software-intensive studies violate this assumption: the protocol is partly implemented, and implementations carry defects. We report a three-case study of protocol repairs ("patches") from a program where an LLM proposes executable rules that a programmatic verifier gates, across production scheduling, incentive design, and task assignment. Each protocol required exactly one defect-repair patch: three events in total. None modified a numbered judgment criterion, its threshold, or the scoring rule, and none altered already collected data; two changed pre-registered design parameters before any data were collected, each with a recorded rationale. We propose a two-axis taxonomy of patches (defect class: environmental / feasibility / correctness, x timing: pre-data / post-data), introduce a verifiable non-impact claim for post-data repairs, and distill a nine-item checklist; all nine items were exercised by at least one patch event -- an observation of use, not a validation of sufficiency. The credibility of verifier-bound, LLM-proposer studies depends less on whether patches occur than on whether they are auditable.
paragraphs.zh: 提出LLM提议者实验中预注册协议修复的分类法与检查清单，强调补丁的可审计性。预注册机制日益被提议作为涉及LLM生成内容的机器学习研究的信任机制，但其规范形式假设一个冻结的协议可以不加更改地执行。 软件密集型研究违背了这一假设：协议只有部分被实现，而实现中带有缺陷。 我们报告了一项针对协议修复（“补丁”）的三案例研究，该研究来自一个由LLM提议可执行规则并由程序化验证器把关的项目，涵盖生产调度、激励设计和任务分配三个领域。 每个协议都恰好需要一次缺陷修复补丁：总共三次事件。 没有任何一次修改了带编号的评判标准、其阈值或评分规则，也没有改动已收集的数据；其中两次在任何数据被收集之前更改了预注册的设计参数，且每次都有记录在案的理由。 我们提出一个补丁的双轴分类法（缺陷类别：环境性／可行性／正确性，时机：数据收集前／数据收集后），针对数据收集后的修复引入可验证的非影响性声明，并提炼出一份九项检查清单；所有九项都被至少一次补丁事件所触发——这是使用情况的观察，而非充分性的验证。 验证器约束、LLM提议者研究的可信度，与其说取决于补丁是否发生，不如说取决于这些补丁是否可审计。
